attributes.action: Improve Funding For Mental Health Services
attributes.additional_details: Improve the social care in thd Bassetlaw District area, giving young people easier accessibility to mental health services. The aim is to improve the social care for young people with autism and other learning disabilities to better support them in the community, giving them the sense of relief and that they're being listened to. Improve the overall social care for each young person in the Bassetlaw District area.
attributes.background: Improve the funding for mental health services within the Bassetlaw District area, allowing young people to easily access the social care they need without the need of fighting for it. Provide more accessibility to mental health services in hospital and community to support special needs who need it
